correctness.rationale: Verified Lemmas 1-4 end to end. Lemma 1: P(O+L) over C^2/Z[i]^2 is compact Kahler 3-fold, E Hermitian-flat hence numerically flat, -K=O(2)xpi*L^vee nef, q=2 by Leray, projection is Albanese submersion. Section 3: rho=diag(1,exp(2pi i theta m1)), c1=c2=0 because unitary-flat c1 is torsion and H^2(T,Z) torsion-free, eta=0, G=0 from coincident fibre/reference metrics (phi=0, E=0) hence definition-independent. Lemma 2: pi1 iso gives every connected cover is P(pi*E) for torus isogeny; disconnected covers cannot be connected T'xP1. Lemma 3: dLambda subset Lambda' and theta=sqrt2/2 irrational gives chi|!=1 so pi*L nontrivial. Lemma 4: nontrivial flat M has H^0=0 so h^0(O+M)=1 vs 2h^0(F) even blocks P-triviality via P(E1)=P(E2) iff E1=E2 tensor F. Script quadrature FS volume 0.99974 and energy 0 confirm.
